# shoal_secret (Resource)

A secret in a namespace, encrypted at rest. Connections, agents and gateways refer to secrets by name. The API never returns the value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. Maps to `/v1/namespaces/{namespace}/secrets/{name}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shoal_secret" "jira_token" {
  namespace = "payments"
  name      = "jira-api-token"
  value     = var.jira_api_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Secret name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value (write-only on the server).

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace. Defaults to the provider's `namespace`. Secrets are never read across namespaces (not even from `shared`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<namespace>/<name>`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the value was last written.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The value is not returned by the API; set it in configuration after importing.
terraform import shoal_secret.jira_token payments/jira-api-token
```
